'''Institute of Mathematics, Physics, and Mechanics''' ({{langx|sl|Inštitut za matematiko, fiziko in mehaniko}}; '''IMFM''') is the leading [[research institute|research institution]] in the areas of [[mathematics]] and [[theoretical computer science]] in [[Slovenia]]. It includes researchers from [[University of Ljubljana]], [[University of Maribor]] and [[University of Primorska]]. It was founded in 1960.<ref>{{cite web|title=About us|url=http://www.imfm.si/about/about-us/about-us/view?set_language=en|work=IMFM|accessdate=2011-11-12}}</ref>

The IMFM is composed of the following departments:

* Department of Mathematrics
* Department of Physics
* Department of Theoretical Computer Science

The director is [[Peter Šemrl]].
